author: Milwad Khosravi
description: An interactive CLI to scaffold a production-ready PHP/Laravel package in seconds.

Maker-checker approvals for Laravel. Holds Eloquent creates, updates and deletes, pivot writes and custom actions until the right people approve, with multi-step and grouped approvers, rule-based policies, delegation, expiry, escalation, an audit trail, tenancy, and configurable keys and tables.
